source_specific_plans.visual_thesis: A plausible diagnosis is only an intermediate state. At 320px follow diagnosis, challenge and engineer review; at full size inspect onset, affected requests, rollout evidence and the recovery return path.
source_specific_plans.exclusions: No automated engineer approval; no claim every hypothesis is correct; no invented latency readings, guaranteed repair, score or success tick.

source_specific_plans.visual_thesis: Aggregate coding-agent outcomes depend on which agents and repositories enter the pool. At phone scale distinguish pooled records from stratified context; full size reveals agent, repository and workflow as separate dimensions, without claiming a causal effect.
source_specific_plans.exclusions: No brand logos or agent badges; no claim human review causes merging; no quantitative bars, pie proportions, arrow of improvement, invented scores or attribution-as-effort equivalence.

source_specific_plans.visual_thesis: Reported task time changes unevenly. At 320px see less information gathering and writing alongside steady meetings; full size separates survey responses from a proposed direct task audit. No task-share geometry is a measured magnitude.
source_specific_plans.exclusions: No percentage charts, clock readouts, measured time savings, shrinking meeting load, universal productivity gain, AI-caused time claim, or merging survey evidence with an experiment.

source_specific_plans.visual_thesis: Managed routing sends a model request among hosts, but marketplace traffic cannot stand in for enterprise adoption. At 320px distinguish the active network from the disconnected population boundary; full size shows provider selection and bounded retry.
source_specific_plans.exclusions: No adoption percentages, enterprise adoption gauge, guaranteed cheapest provider, security guarantee, universal open-source licensing, logo or invented hosting policy.

source_specific_plans.visual_thesis: A recommendation should carry definitions, quality and lineage through an access boundary. At 320px see context grounded above a review threshold; full size follow three distinct evidence relationships without treating vendor claims as verified outcomes.
source_specific_plans.exclusions: No universal permission bypass, automatic trust certification, guaranteed data quality, fabricated audit text, approval tick, human avatar or product screenshot.

source_specific_plans.visual_thesis: An edit is auditable only when cuts and export are checked. At 320px follow aligned cuts into validation and human review; full size reveals word differences, frame inspection, loudness and synchronization as distinct checks without claiming editing quality.
source_specific_plans.exclusions: No human in frames, optional paid service as required step, actual measured loudness values, invented quality score, false approval check, fake transcript writing or generated guarantees.
